about: Zones of Craiova airport T2 for the crowd-operations frontend and the sim's KPIs; world frame: x east, z north, metres (Unity world). polygons_px are pixels of the level's base image.

parter.title: T2 - Parter (Ground floor)
parter.world_to_pixel: px = (x - x0) * ppm; py = (z1 - z) * ppm

etaj1.title: T2 - Etaj 1 (Upper floor)
etaj1.world_to_pixel: px = (x - x0) * ppm; py = (z1 - z) * ppm

exterior.title: Exterior T2 (landside + apron)
exterior.world_to_pixel: px = (x - x0) * ppm; py = (z1 - z) * ppm
